titulo_ja: ものだ と ものか (1)

あって.es: (forma て de あう) encontrarse; quedar

texto: You can express a general comment or emotion: phrase in normal form + **ものだ**: **こども は すぐ おおきく なる もの だ** (children grow up fast; it's normal).
With **Vたものだ**, habits of the past are also remembered; the context distinguishes these uses.
In **ものだ**, the speaker presents a generalization, a memory or an emotion; **のです** usually explains or contextualizes a specific situation. They are not interchangeable in all cases.
